## Endpoints

This capability unlocks 2 endpoint(s).

- **`GET /memberships/bookings`**: List Membership Bookings.
  - **membership[id]** (string (uuid), in query, required): Membership identifier returned by `/memberships/lookup`.
  - **membership[verification]** (string, in query, required): Verification token from lookup (OTP for email/mobile, or guest name for reference).
  - **membership[email]** (string (email), in query): Membership email used during lookup.
  - **membership[mobile]** (string, in query): Membership mobile number used during lookup.
  - **membership[country]** (string, in query): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to parse `membership[mobile]`.
  - **membership[reference]** (string, in query): Membership reference used during lookup.
- **`POST /memberships/lookup`**: Membership Lookup. Body `MembershipLookupRequest`.

## Schemas introduced by this capability

5 schema(s) exist only when `octo/memberships` is active.

### `Membership`

Required: `id`, `title`, `availabilityLocalDateStart`, `availabilityLocalDateEnd`.

- **id** (string (uuid), required): Unique identifier for this resource. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **title** (string, required): Membership title label. Example: `"Annual Membership"`.
- **contact** (Contact, optional, nullable): Membership contact object.
- **reference** (string, optional, nullable): Membership reference value. Example: `"REF-2026-001"`.
- **resellerReference** (string, optional, nullable): Reseller-facing membership reference value. Example: `"RES-MEM-10045"`.
- **supplierReference** (string, optional, nullable): Supplier-facing membership reference value. Example: `"SUP-MEM-7782"`.
- **availabilityLocalDateStart** (string (date), required): Membership validity start date in the product timezone. Example: `"2026-01-01"`.
- **availabilityLocalDateEnd** (string (date), required): Membership validity end date in the product timezone. Example: `"2026-12-31"`.

### `MembershipBenefit`

- **id** (string (uuid), optional): Unique identifier for this resource. Example: `"e7cc8bb4-8d1c-4848-8824-5dbedb718681"`.
- **title** (string, optional): Title value. Example: `"Summer Promotion"`.
- **description** (string, optional): Description value. Example: `"Morning departure with central pickup included."`.

### `MembershipContext`

Required: `id`, `verification`.

- **id** (string (uuid), required): Membership identifier returned by `/memberships/lookup`. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **email** (string (email), optional): Membership email used during lookup. Example: `"jane.doe@goldengatetours.com"`.
- **mobile** (string, optional): Membership mobile number used during lookup. Example: `"+12025550123"`.
- **country** (string, optional): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to parse `mobile`. Example: `"US"`.
- **reference** (string, optional): Membership reference used during lookup. Example: `"REF-2026-001"`.
- **verification** (string, required): Verification token from lookup (OTP for email/mobile, or guest name for reference). Example: `"123456"`.

### `MembershipLookupRequest`

- **country** (string, optional): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to parse `mobile`. Example: `"US"`.
- **email** (string (email), optional): Email address used for membership lookup. Example: `"jane.doe@goldengatetours.com"`.
- **mobile** (string, optional): Mobile number used for membership lookup. Example: `"+12025550123"`.
- **page** (integer, optional): Page number for paginated membership results. Example: `1`.
- **reference** (string, optional): Membership reference used for lookup. Example: `"REF-2026-001"`.
- **verification** (string, optional): Verification token (OTP for email/mobile, or guest name for reference lookup). Example: `"123456"`.

### `MembershipLookupResponse`

Required: `verified`, `memberships`.

- **verified** (boolean, required): Whether membership verification is complete for this lookup. Example: `true`.
- **message** (string, optional, nullable): Verification guidance message for follow-up lookup requests. Example: `"A verification email has been sent to jane.doe@goldengatetours.com"`.
- **memberships** (Membership[], required): List of memberships matching the lookup criteria.

## Integration notes

From [docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/memberships](https://docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/memberships).

### Lookup is a two-step verification

`POST /memberships/lookup` takes **one** of `email`, `mobile` or `reference` (a `reference` must be
at least 3 characters).

1. **First call** — no memberships found returns `400 Bad Request`. Found returns
   `"verified": false`.
2. **Second call** — repeat the same request with `verification` added.

What that verification value is depends on the identifier:

| Identifier | `verification` value |
|---|---|
| `reference` | the guest's **last name** |
| `email` | a 6-digit code sent to that email address |
| `mobile` | a 6-digit code sent to that number |

If several memberships come back, let the guest pick — use `title` and `contact` to tell them apart.

### Passing the membership onward

After lookup, include a `membership` object on membership-aware requests, or `membership[...]` query
parameters on `GET` endpoints. `membership[id]` is **required**, plus one of `membership[email]`,
`membership[mobile]` or `membership[reference]`, together with `membership[verification]`.

`membership[mobile]` additionally needs `membership[country]` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) so the number can
be parsed.

### Product benefits add units

A membership can carry several benefits, and each benefit **adds units** to the product's unit list.
Tell them apart by the `membershipBenefit` object, which is `null` on ordinary units.

Ventrata's own rendering recommendation:

> Group units by `membershipBenefit.id` and display those units in a highlighted box. Units with
> `"membershipBenefit": null` should go at the end — these are the regular units that were not made
> available with the membership.

Include benefit units in `unitItems` exactly like normal units, and keep sending the `membership`
object on the booking request — otherwise the benefit does not apply.

### Where membership data appears

- **`unit.membershipBenefit`** — on a unit added by a benefit; `null` on ordinary units. Carries
  `membershipBenefit.id`, `title` and `description`.
- **`offer.membershipBenefit`** — when an offer comes from a membership benefit. The offer's own
  `title` and `description` describe it to the guest.
- **`order.membership`** — the membership applied to a multi-booking order (`octo/cart`).
- **`unit.restrictions.maxQuantity`** — benefit units are usually capped; read the restriction rather
  than assuming one per booking.

Group by `membershipBenefit.id` for display, and keep sending the `membership` object on every write
call in the flow — dropping it on confirm loses the benefit.
